name: SOF lateral spine radiographs (Study of Osteoporotic Fractures)
what: the women's counterpart of MrOS: lateral thoracolumbar films at several visits, about 9,700 women, Genant grading per vertebra; counts to confirm on the page
level_truth: Genant grades on named levels, so level truth exists
status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; asked SOF's data team on 2026-10-22 for leave to register; they answered the same day that SOF Online is closed to registrations while it is changed for new NIH requirements and will write when it reopens, and that the study images are being moved to the NIA Aging Research Biobank (agingresearchbiobank.nia.nih.gov), to which the image request goes; no request there yet; with MrOS the largest level-labelled lateral spine film resource that exists
licence: a SOF data request agreement; terms to confirm on the page
how_to_get: Open https://sofonline.ucsf.edu/ and read the data request route, to confirm on the page.
The owner files the request in the owner's name and signs whatever agreement follows; a session drafts the proposal text once the owner asks.
Once granted, fetch by the route the centre gives, as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node.
